description: This pie chart, titled "w/o Reference Answer and Test Case," visually represents the distribution of three categories within a dataset: "Null" (represented by a pink slice, accounting for 39.2% of the total), "Have reference answer" (represented by a blue slice, accounting for 38.9% of the total), and "Have test case" (represented by a green slice, accounting for 21.9% of the total). The chart is divided into three distinct segments, each clearly labeled with its category name and corresponding percentage value directly on the chart. A legend in the top-left corner corroborates these labels with their respective colors and includes the raw counts for each category: Null (549,238), Have reference answer (543,935), and Have test case (306,818). The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the "Null" slice being the largest, followed by "Have reference answer," and then "Have test case." No slices are visually emphasized through explosion or bolding, and the chart does not include any additional graphical elements beyond the three colored segments and their associated labels.
